title: The most moist, sweet, fluffy banana bread ever (and it has no butter!)
summary: You have to try this banana bread!
steps: Did you know if you mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, coconut sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt?
Then mix mashed banana, oil, vanilla and almond milk.
Fold it all together with chopped walnuts.
Bake for 50 minutes until golden and fluffy.
